title: Caramelized Fennel and Thyme Gravy
description: Thinly sliced fennel turns sweet in butter and blends into a pale thyme gravy for chicken or pork.
equipment: Immersion blender and tall heatproof jug

ingredients.name: trimmed fresh fennel bulb
ingredients.note: Remove tough core and stalks before weighing and slice thinly.

steps.title: Caramelize the fennel
steps.text: Melt half of {butter} in the HexClad over medium-low heat. Cook {fennel} for 12–18 minutes, stirring until fully soft and golden. Use a splash of {broth} if the edges brown too quickly.

steps.title: Soften the fennel core
steps.text: Add {thyme} and the rest of the broth. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes until every slice is tender.

steps.title: Puree the fennel
steps.text: Blend the fennel and its cooking broth in the deep jug. Press through a fine sieve to catch any fibers.

steps.title: Cook the roux
steps.text: Melt the remaining butter in the empty skillet. Whisk in {flour} over low heat for 1–2 minutes until it smells lightly toasted.

steps.title: Build the gravy
steps.text: Whisk the strained fennel broth into the roux in stages. Simmer for 2–3 minutes until the gravy coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Check the yield
steps.text: Measure the finished sauce in a heatproof cup. Aim for 1 1/2 cups total. If it measures short, whisk in a little hot water. If it measures over, return it to the skillet and simmer briefly to the mark.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle over moist chicken thighs, pork loin or mashed sweet potato.

notes: Yield: 1 1/2 cups. One serving is 1/4 cup. Make ahead: Caramelize the fennel a day ahead and refrigerate it with its broth. Refrigerate in shallow covered portions within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze the finished gravy in small portions for up to 2 months. Whisk after thawing to smooth the roux. Fridge reheat: Bring a portion to a boil in a small pan, stirring until it reaches at least 165°F. Loosen with a little water as needed. Freezer reheat: Thaw in the refrigerator overnight and reheat as for a chilled portion. For dairy-free gravy, use avocado oil in place of the butter and divide it between the fennel and roux in the same proportions. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/6 of recipe): 43 kcal, 1.0 g protein, 2.9 g total carbohydrate, 3.3 g fat, 0.8 g fiber, 23 mg sodium. The estimate covers the prepared condiment. Add separately served foods when totaling a meal. Fiber is estimated before straining.
